seoTitle: Wolf’s Terminal: an atlas of my orchestration harness
seoDescription: How I run a team of AI agents: one task, from my message to the result, every feature explained by me.
seoKeywords: Wolf’s Terminal, orchestration harness, AI agents
welcomeBanner: AN ATLAS OF MY ORCHESTRATION HARNESS
introStoryBody: This is how I run a team of AI agents. One task travels from my message to the result, and every tile on the map is a feature I built along that path. Click a tile and I explain what it does for me and why it exists.
introDepthValue: Ownership and the life of one task
principles: Every card is a feature I use daily. Where I say something works, a journal on my server says it too.
legendProductDesc: a stage or what supports it
legendSolidDesc: arrows: the order of a task
securityIntroDesc: These are the domains of access and accountability on my server. The rings group them. It is not a security certificate.
agentsSubtitle: Project operators act within the grants I recorded. Shared infrastructure belongs to The Order.
agentsPunchline: Permission rules say what an agent may do. They say nothing about technical isolation.
patternsSubtitle: The mechanisms that keep context and record what happened.
